# {{PROJECT_NAME}}

> LLM-readable navigation map for this AI-assisted project.

## Start here

- `AGENTS.md`: cross-agent project instructions
- `CLAUDE.md`: Claude Code addendum

## Core operating system

- `docs/KARPATHY_PRINCIPLES_AND_COMMUNITY_RULES.md`: four named principles and four community safety rules
- `docs/CONTEXT_ENGINEERING_DISCIPLINE.md`: context engineering as a discipline
- `docs/LLM_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md`: raw/wiki/schema knowledge base
- `docs/SPEC_DRIVEN_DEVELOPMENT_OS.md`: persistent spec-driven development workflow
- `docs/AUTO_ACCEPT_SELF_VERIFICATION.md`: bounded autonomous verification loop
- `docs/AUTO_RESEARCH_LOOP.md`: controlled project OS improvement loop
- `docs/CROSS_FUNCTIONAL_ENABLEMENT.md`: non-engineering workflow-to-tool process

## Claude Code assets
